# boqount v0.2.0

Product films get a new shape, sound gets a method, and one account can now be run from several machines.

## Films

- **The opportunity story,** the default shape for a film that shows your product (`skills/boqount/story.md`):
  60 to 85 seconds in ten parts. A sourced number about something everyone knows is on the first frame. The product
  is named once, near the end. Scenes change on spoken words, captions carry the film with the sound off, and it does
  not loop. The format comes from a single reference film, so the skill treats it as a test until two of your own
  films in it have been measured.
- **One comment call, and only with someone to answer it.** A product film ends on "Comment &lt;code&gt;, and I'll
  send you the link." in its voice and its caption. The call is used only once you have confirmed who sends that link:
  a DM automation you run, or you by hand. Onboarding asks. Without a confirmed route the film is held. Niche
  episodes still ask for nothing, and "follow" or "link in bio" are never added.
- **New kit parts:** `Captions` (two or three words at a time in one fixed band), `WorldChange` (a short pan or a
  cut on a word, never a dissolve) and `Call` (the comment typed and its reply arriving). A product film starts from
  `film.mjs new <slug> --story`.
- **The starter film rebuilt** in the new format: 69 seconds, ten worlds, for an invented plant app.
- **Nothing flashes:** no large part of the frame goes from dark to bright more than three times in a second.
  `tools/flashes.mjs` measures it on the feed file.
- **Real labels, read again:** before a film shows a panel of your product, the product's page or app is read again
  and its labels are recorded with the date.
- **A film modelled on a reference** takes its structure and devices, never its words, pictures, colours or product.

## Sound

- **Levels set against the voice:** a sheet format (v2) with beds, dips, ducking and a build aligned to its peak,
  mixed by `tools/mix2.mjs` to −14 LUFS and no more than −1 dBTP, with stems and a record of what played.
- **A check for every rule:** `tools/soundcheck.mjs` prints one line per rule of the sound method, then the long
  sounds and the planned silences.
- **A sound library you generate with your own ElevenLabs key** (`tools/soundlib.mjs`), from a spec of 56 sounds,
  with a pitched set synthesized in the key of your music. No generated sound files are included: ElevenLabs'
  terms do not allow passing them on as a library. Without a key, the free synthesized kit still works.

## Running the account

- **Several people, one account:** `tools/account-lock.mjs` lets one run at a time hold the account through its
  shared remote. A stale lock is taken over and named, and only a person frees someone else's fresh one.
- **A dated fact is read again on the posting day,** and a fact that has turned false stops the post.
- **Instagram's current insight names** (Viewers, skip rate) are read from screenshots into the right fields.
- **Research:** what makes a film with no product travel, written as a claim to test both ways. Series carry a
  length, and a new series is judged after three episodes, not one.
- **The credit for outside material** is the caption's last line of words. A hashtag line may follow it.

## Repository

- A new README, made for a phone, with a demo and a way to email the install line to yourself.
